en: A black‑and‑white photograph of a large Renaissance-style castle or manor complex situated by a wide, curving river in open countryside. The ensemble includes tall rectangular towers with stepped gables and small cupolas, long residential wings with steep tiled roofs and dormer windows, and farm or garden buildings in the foreground. Trees and formal gardens surround the buildings, with expansive agricultural fields and a tree line along the distant riverbank.
